clues: John Wood the Elder and his son designed many of its grandest streets in the 18th century.
It is the only entire city in the UK designated a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Jane Austen lived here from 1801 to 1806 and set parts of Northanger Abbey and Persuasion here.
The Royal Crescent and Pulteney Bridge are among its best-known sights.
Its Roman spa, fed by natural hot springs, gives this Somerset city its name.
